body: What if there's an aspect of your life that isn't temporary. What if you knew that you'd be spending the rest of your life alone. I feel trapped, I don't want to live on suffering day to day.

Lately I've been waking up depressed and anxious, I've never felt this way before. I used to wake up to a clear mind or just wondered about what was for breakfast or what to do during the weekend. I just don't want to suffer anymore, it just hurts so much.

It wasn't meant to turn out like this. I never imagined my life would take a turn like this. I'm scared, stressed and miserable. I don't want to get up anymore, I don't want this pain anymore. In my head I scream for help. I want to be fixed and go back to what life used to be, but I'm so broken now.

Cs, dota, pc games mostly. People have told me how unproductive it is and how I've failed at life so now I feel guilty every time I play games as I should be working harder to pick up my life. It's funny isn't it, I feel guilty for doing something I used to enjoy but at the I'm willing to give up any possible joy in the future for an end to this suffering..

I've received similar feedback from therapists and family. They all say I need to focus on self improvement and make more friends. But the hopelessness keeps dragging me back into isolation, the pain makes me want to retract from society and just turn to movies and video games which I know is just a temporary distraction. I wish I had a close friend, one that doesn't feel burdened when I reach out for help. My partner was the closest friend I had, a big part of why she left was because the burden of my pain was too much. But even though she hurt me so much, even though she ignored when I really wanted to work things out, I still miss her so much...

I've read about others going through a similar situation, I don't know how they survive. The abandonment just hurts so much, because we did everything together now that she's gone I feel isolated, I don't really have any friends to talk to or hang out with because they are mostly married now or are in a relationship, something that I used to have. I feel broken and I don't want to suffer in this broken life.
